newsitem.title: GERMANY: EMI choses SWIFT for payment system under EMU.
newsitem.headline: EMI choses SWIFT for payment system under EMU.

text.p: The European Monetary Institute (EMI) said on Friday it had chosen SWIFT, the international payment systems co-operative, as the network for the TARGET payment system under the European single currency.
"Our working group on international payments looked at the (SWIFT) system, tested it and reached a final agreement that this was the right software to use," a spokeswoman for the EMI said.
She said representatives from all European Union central banks were part of the payments working group.

In a statement released in Frankfurt, Brussels-based SWIFT confirmed it had signed a deal with the EMI to provide a communication net on which to run Trans-European Automated Real Time Gross Settlement Express Transfer (TARGET).
The EMI is the forerunner to the European Central Bank (ECB).
